note: Morton County KS (FIPS 20129): county appraiser site links only to the state ORKA parcel viewer; ORKA parcel data is obtained by registered request through the ORKA Portal, one county at a time. No public queryable parcel service or file found. KansasGIS services (services.kansasgis.org ORKA/KS_ORKA_Extras) have no Morton parcel polygon layer. The ArcGIS Hub 'Morton County' Parcels layer holds Morton County, North Dakota data. Only commercial shapefile vendors (Dynamo, Rockford, Equator) offer Morton KS parcels.
